card.name: Words just before "efficiency"
card.fires_on: The word or symbol right before an expected "efficiency" or "efficiently", such as "percent", "%", "energy", "high" or "more". It appears in energy and solar-power text.

modes.label: Percent before efficiency
modes.description: A percent sign or the word percent after a number, where "efficiency" comes next.
modes.example: In 1992, the University of South Florida produced a thin-film photovoltaic cell system that operated at 15.9<<%>> efficiency.

modes.label: Modifier before efficiency
modes.description: Words like energy, high, more or a possessive 's that lead into efficiency or efficient.
modes.example: Geothermal furnaces are another renewable option with zero emissions and<< high>> efficiency.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of efficiency words as the next word, so the model avoids repeating them.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before "efficiency" in energy-system text, when that word is already expected next.
